name: text-texture-fill
title: Texture / Video Fill
description: Chữ rất đậm làm khuôn cắt cho ảnh, video hoặc hoạ tiết bên trong; phần hình trôi chậm qua lòng chữ còn nét chữ đứng yên.

moworks.author: moworks

options.image: a picture to run inside the letters (an assets/ path); none: a drawn pattern (gradient, wavy lines, rising bubbles)
options.period: s for one pass across, ping-pong (20; 0 → 100 % in 20 s)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here
credit.upstream: after Magic UI (MIT); a faithful port is in the Magic UI collection

moworks.notes: Heavy text (weight 900, 10–20 vw) as a mask over an image / video / pattern (background-clip text, or a mask with mask-size contain for video), fill 200 % of the box, vertical position 50 %; background-position-x 0 % → 100 % over 20 s linear, ping-pong (CSS alternate) (a 5 s shot moves 25 %); video frame-locked to the film; letters still. Demo pattern: blue → accent gradient with 2 px wavy lines that drift 10 px and rising bubbles per 5 s loop. Params: fill: ảnh / video / hoạ tiết · drift: trôi nền (0 → 100 % trong 20 s) · size: cỡ nền (200 %).
moworks.titleVi: Ảnh hoặc video chạy trong lòng chữ
